verdict.rationale: Fin is itself the built-in AI agent: teams hand it support work through Procedures that run multi-step queries with business logic and third-party systems end to end, and it takes actions that update external systems. Fin Tasks, Guidance and escalation rules shape how delegated work is handled, and Copilot is mentioned as an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration that delegation works as claimed, in-depth docs on Fin Tasks and Operator beyond article titles, and evidence of ad-hoc delegation by internal users rather than pre-configured customer-facing automation.
